1) Chromatin Structure Regulation
Chromatin Remodeling Complexes can also add methyl or acetyl groups onto histones for further regulation of DNA regions
explanation: Chromatin Remodeling Complexes are not only responsible for shifting histones along DNA, but they can also actively add or remove chemical groups—specifically methyl and acetyl groups—on histone tails, directing the cell's local chromatin structure and regulating gene transcription.

questions.q: What chemical groups can Chromatin Remodeling Complexes add to histones to regulate DNA regions?
questions.exp: Option B is correct because the slide states: 'Chromatin Remodeling Complexes can also add methyl or acetyl groups onto histones for further regulation of DNA regions.' The other groups are incorrect.
